reason: The ibex bounds back (leapfrog) in its lull instead of hiding in the trees (the coordinator, 2026-10-29). No creature jumps in a fight (Ed's playtest, 2026-10-29: "some animals seem to teleport"): a pack member hidden in its lull (trees, burrow, water, branches) or scattered runs, unseen, toward where it comes back down instead of being put there when its hide ends; a leap goes on along its arc through steps something else holds it (a stun), and one whose target is lost finishes its arc instead of being put at its landing. A hiding pack member is drawn as a see-through shadow of itself (combat.packs.shadow), not left out.

frames.*: in a fight with a hiding, scattering or leaping kind, those creatures stand somewhere else after their lull or leap; a hiding one shows as a dark see-through shadow instead of nothing

rules.creatures: the positions of pack members after a hide or scatter, and of leapers stunned or left without a target mid-leap
rules.*: anything downstream of where those creatures stand (the fight's hits, who's near her)
